params.message:
Subpage headers as drawn in the header maquette of 30 October 2026

Posts, Trends, Services, Pricing and AI tools get the split hero: the
designer's narrow picture A on the left with the page name in orange, the
Newsreader heading in the middle with the name large and pale behind it,
and the wide picture B running into the right edge. Reports and Contact get
the single hero: heading left, one picture right. One component,
<x-page-hero>, replaces the black-and-white collage bands on these pages.

From lg up the composition is the 1701-wide drawing scaled to the band in
cqw, never lower than 380px. Below lg, where nothing is drawn, picture A
(or the single picture) comes first at full width and B is not fetched.

The pictures are AVIF and WebP at their own width and a smaller one, with
the original's width and height on every img; bin/heroes.py makes them from
the delivery. The originals are not committed.

PageHeroesTest holds a hero per page, the page's own pictures and no other
page's, alt text and dimensions on every picture, every copy present, and B
not fetched on a phone.
